issues.message: Only 151 blocks: too bare for a landmark (at least 200). Carlton wants more detail, not less.
18 % detail blocks: on the bare side, aim for 20 %+.
stone_bricks is 60 % of the build: break it up with a second material.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.artefacts: Open 1-block notches at the front corners of both towers, (0,2,0), (6,2,0), (0,6,0), (6,6,0), read as broken corners (L2 fills them with iron bars).
notes.roof: Each tower is capped by two rows of spruce stairs back to back (y8) that look like flat wooden boards: no overhang, no gable trim, the stair ends show at z0 and z3.
notes.purpose: Reads as a gate: an arched opening between two towers with the walk crossing over.
notes.materials: Stone bricks 60 % with random cobble patches; the spruce caps feel stuck on.
notes.grandeur: Towers rise only one block above the merlons; small for a landmark gate.

visual.summary: Gate module: two 2x4 stone towers flanking a 3-wide arched opening, with the wall walk running over the arch and through the towers at y5.
problems: Corner notches (0,2,0), (6,2,0), (0,6,0), (6,6,0) are open in L1 and look like missing blocks: fill them with stone or make them proper slits away from the corner.
Tower caps: replace the flat spruce stair pairs at y8 with a real top (merlons, or a steeper roof with overhang and trimmed gable ends).
Towers barely rise above the wall (top y8 vs merlons y6): make them 2-3 taller so the gate stands out as a landmark.
Joins: walk at y5 (z1-2), walk floor y4 and parapet z0 match stone_wall_straight; merlons at x1,3,5 keep the even-x alternation of the straight pieces across the join. OK.
Reachability: the walk (x0..6 y5 z1-2) has no stair in this piece; it is reached only from a neighbouring wall_tower - fine for a module.

issues.message: 151 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
stone_bricks is 61 % of the build: break it up with a second material.

notes.artefacts: Last round's open corner notches are filled.
notes.roof: Towers now end in chequered merlons at y8 (2 above the wall merlons, roof y7) instead of flat spruce stair caps: fixed.
notes.materials: 61 % stone bricks: big plain tower faces, only a few cobble patches.
notes.depth: Battered foot and a corbel course in line with the parapet now; tower sides and backs still flat.
notes.life: Lanterns hanging in the arch, torches in the opening.

visual.summary: Level 1 gate: two crenellated towers either side of a 3-wide arched opening with lanterns, the walk crossing over the arch and through both towers.
problems: Tower faces are mostly plain stone brick (61 %); more cobble/mossy patches or a string course on the tower sides would break them up (minor).
Inside the passage the clear height is 2 (y0-1 at z1-z2 under the arch stairs and lanterns at y2): fine for soldiers and players.

Joins: walk floor y4 / stand y5 (z1-2), corbel course y4 z0 and footing stairs y0 z0 match stone_wall_straight v2; the open tower sides at x0/x6 y5-6 are the walk entries. OK. The walk has no stair here (reached from a neighbouring piece), fine for a module.
